 class CategoryController {
 +create(CategoryRequest, MultipartFile) CategoryResponse

 +delete(String categoryId)
 }

 <<interface>>
 +fetch(page, size, sortBy, orderedBy) Page~CategoryResponse~
 +delete(String categoryId)
 +create(CategoryRequest, MultipartFile) CategoryResponse
 }

 -CategoryRepository categoryRepository
 -StorageService storageService
 -CategoryImageValidation imageValidation
 }
 class CategoryRepository {
 <<interface>>
 +findByCategoryId(String) Optional~Category~

 }

 +Long id
 +String categoryId
 +String name
 +String description
 +String imageKey
 +Timestamp createdAt
 +Timestamp updatedAt
 }
 class CategoryImageValidation {
 +validate(MultipartFile)
 }
 class CategoryAlreadyExists {
 <<exception>>
 }
 class CategoryDeletionException {
 <<exception>>
 }

 CategoryController --> CategoryService
 CategoryService <|.. CategoryServiceImpl
 CategoryServiceImpl --> CategoryRepository
 CategoryServiceImpl --> CategoryImageValidation
 CategoryRepository --> Category
 CategoryServiceImpl ..> CategoryAlreadyExists : throws
 CategoryServiceImpl ..> CategoryDeletionException : throws",
